scripts.generate:client: uv run --project ../engine python -m market_research_lab.export_openapi && openapi-typescript ../engine/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.ts && node scripts/fix_schema.js

scripts.build: npm run generate:client && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build
